name: Warner Bros. Discovery
description: Warner Bros. Discovery owns one of Hollywood's big film and TV studios (Warner Bros., DC, Harry Potter), the HBO and HBO Max streaming services (131.6 million subscribers at the end of 2025), and a large portfolio of TV networks (CNN, HGTV, Food Network and others). Streaming earns subscription and ad revenue, Studios earns from films, TV production and licensing, and the Global Linear Networks earn fees from cable and satellite distributors plus advertising; that last business is the profit pool (62 percent of segment EBITDA in 2025) but shrinking (EBITDA down 21 percent in 2025). The company has agreed to be acquired for cash by Paramount Skydance (PSKY) for $31.00 a share after ending an earlier Netflix deal in February 2026; twelve state attorneys general and two writers' guilds sued in July 2026 to block it.

businessLines.name: Global Linear Networks
businessLines.how: Cable and satellite companies pay per-subscriber carriage fees for the networks (distribution), and advertisers pay to reach linear viewers; shrinks as households cut cable and ad demand falls, but cash margins are high.
businessLines.description: Domestic and international pay-TV networks (legacy Discovery and WarnerMedia cable and broadcast channels)

businessLines.name: Studios
businessLines.how: Film and TV output earns box-office share, licence fees from streamers and networks (including WBD's own), and home entertainment; lumpy because results follow the release slate.
businessLines.description: Feature films for theatrical release, TV production and licensing to third parties and internal services, home entertainment, consumer products, themed experiences and interactive games

businessLines.name: Streaming
businessLines.how: Monthly subscriptions (retail and wholesale bundles with partners) with ad-free and ad-lite tiers; growth from subscribers, price rises and international rollout.
businessLines.description: HBO Max, discovery+, HBO premium channel, and premium sports streaming products

businessLines.description: Corporate costs and internal sales removed in consolidation
